professionalSummary.text: Project manager in the store development team at Brackley Home & Garden since July 2020, managing refits of stores between 30,000 and 60,000 square feet.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager in the store development team at Brackley Home & Garden, July 2020 to present, running refits of stores between 30,000 and 60,000 square feet.

experienceHighlights.text: Built integrated refit schedules in the planning tool, linking strip-out, mechanical and electrical works, fixture installation and stock replenishment.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the integrated refit schedules in the planning tool, linking strip-out, mechanical and electrical works, fixture installation and stock replenishment.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked refit budgets against approved capital spend and reported monthly variances to the property director with commentary on change orders.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tracked each refit budget against the approved capital spend and reported monthly variances to the property director, with commentary on change orders.

experienceHighlights.text: Agreed overnight and weekend working windows with store managers to keep customer areas open during works and issued weekly works notices listing closed areas and hoarding positions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Agreed overnight and weekend working windows with store managers so that customer areas stayed open during the works, and issued a weekly works notice to each store listing the areas closed and the hoarding positions.

experienceHighlights.text: Attended weekly progress meetings with main contractors, kept meeting actions lists, and logged variation requests for the commercial manager to assess.
experienceHighlights.witness: Attended weekly progress meetings with the main contractors, kept the meeting actions list and logged their variation requests for the commercial manager to assess.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Anonymised refit schedule for one store showing an 11-week programme, critical path through mechanical and electrical works, and stock replenishment plan for reopening.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an anonymised refit schedule for one store, showing the 11-week programme, the critical path through mechanical and electrical works and the stock replenishment plan for reopening.

skills.text: PRINCE2 Practitioner certification held since May 2022, verified on the accrediting body's successful-candidate register.
skills.witness: Recruiter verification note: the candidate's PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate was checked on the accrediting body's successful-candidate register; it is listed as current, with the examination recorded in May 2022.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building integrated schedules, managing contractors, controlling budgets, coordinating with store teams, and holding a PRINCE2 certification. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct management of disputes or the specific environment (e.g., production vs. pilot) for the refits.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified claims about dispute resolution and environment of refits.

evidence.text: Built the integrated refit schedules in the planning tool, linking strip-out, mechanical and electrical works, fixture installation and stock replenishment.
Attended weekly progress meetings with the main contractors, kept the meeting actions list and logged their variation requests for the commercial manager to assess.
evidence.notes: Logs variations but does not resolve disputes

evidence.text: Tracked each refit budget against the approved capital spend and reported monthly variances to the property director, with commentary on change orders.

Agreed overnight and weekend working windows with store managers so that customer areas stayed open during the works, and issued a weekly works notice to each store listing the areas closed and the hoarding positions.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses coordination with store teams

evidence.text: Recruiter verification note: the candidate's PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate was checked on the accrediting body's successful-candidate register; it is listed as current, with the examination recorded in May 2022.
